report:
Reviewed the complete meta.reviews.output_format claim, its one ordinary implementation association in crates/sage-meta/src/review.rs, and both ordinary associated integration tests. There are no TODO or N/A entries. Captured the fixture/setup helpers, review workflow skill, and review specification as additional dependencies.

The required output has exactly reviewer: String, report: String, and requested_edits: Vec<String>. ValidationOutput declares precisely those fields and denies unknown fields during deserialization. record serializes that supplied object directly through write_json; load_saved deserializes the same type. output_error rejects trimmed-empty reviewer or report and each trimmed-empty requested edit, and both record and load_saved call it. The supplied report is preserved as text, not generated from or replaced by internal reasoning. A concrete requested edit survives record/load unchanged.

The qualitative obligations (complete claim-specific explanation covering every requirement, implementation evidence and test adequacy; separating inspection from execution; concrete changes for revalidation) are reviewer responsibilities enforced by the captured PROMPT and checklist workflow, not assertions that the JSON parser semantically understands prose. The prompt explicitly requests enumeration, evidence tracing, dependency capture, and the inspection/execution distinction; the checklist specifies complete anchor-specific explanation and concrete nonblank changes. This report follows those obligations. Source judgment does not equate format acceptance with semantic approval.

invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review visibly checks rejection of whitespace-only reviewer, empty report, and whitespace-only requested edit without output publication. It records a concrete edit, compares the complete reloaded output to the supplied value, checks that unresolved edits keep validation failing, and asserts exactly three JSON keys with no decision/outcome fields. completed_corrupt_records_and_invalid_layout_cannot_pass exercises persisted malformed output, blank reviewer/report/edit and an extra field, requiring failure through library and CLI and specific diagnostics. Other branches in those complete tests cover stale inputs and layout and do not substitute for the output-specific assertions. Together the tests would detect accepting blank fields, permitting extra output fields, or losing/changing a supplied report or edit. Empty edit lists are also exercised by the captured fixture approval used in the corruption test.

Execution: cargo test -p sage-meta --test review invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review -- --exact passed (1 test). cargo test -p sage-meta --test review completed_corrupt_records_and_invalid_layout_cannot_pass -- --exact passed (1 test). Other conclusions above come from source inspection. No implementation or test edits were needed.
